slides.title: The Put Option
slides.content: A 'Put Option' gives you the right to SELL 100 shares at a specific Strike Price. You buy a Put when you think the stock is going to CRASH.

slides.title: Insurance
slides.content: Investors often buy Puts as insurance (hedging). If you own $100,000 of Apple stock, you can buy Put options. If Apple crashes, your stock loses value, but your Put options gain massive value, saving your portfolio!

slides.title: Zero Sum Game
slides.content: Options trading is a zero-sum game. For you to make $1,000 on an option trade, whoever sold you that contract lost $1,000.

quiz.question: You would buy a Put Option if you believe...

options.text: The stock price is going to crash
options.explanation: Puts gain value as the underlying stock price falls.

The stock will pay a high dividend

quiz.question: Using options to protect your portfolio from a crash is known as...

options.explanation: Hedging is like buying insurance for your investments.

quiz.question: If an option is a 'Zero Sum Game', that means...

options.text: Every dollar won by a buyer is a dollar lost by a seller
options.explanation: Options simply transfer money between participants.
